items.headline: Greer (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Monday.
items.text: Greer suffered an upper-body injury in Sunday's 6-3 win over Ottawa. He will miss at least the next four games, starting with Tuesday's matchup against Vancouver, but it's unclear when he will be ready to return. Greer has four goals, six points, 23 shots on net and 36 hits in 13 appearances this season.

items.headline: Greer scored two goals and added three hits in Tuesday's 6-5 overtime loss to the Canucks.
items.text: Greer has been productive with four goals and an assist over his last five games. He's mostly played on the fourth line lately, though the Ducks have mixed and matched their combinations regularly this season. Greer has six points, 20 shots on net, 27 hits, 28 PIM and an even plus-minus rating through 11 outings overall. That's a scoring pace that would show last year's 32-point campaign with the Panthers wasn't a fluke.

items.text: "Troy is closer. When I say closer, hopefully, definitely, in the next, I'm gonna say, week or so," Quenneville told Lee. Terry hasn't played yet this campaign because of the injury. items.headline: Head coach Peter Laviolette said Thursday that Fiala (lower leg) remains on a week-to-week timeline, Zach Dooley of the Kings' official site reports.
items.text: Fiala skated in a non-contact sweater during Thursday's morning skate, but Laviolette said later in the day that the 30-year-old still has several steps he needs to take before he's in consideration to return to game action. Fiala has been unavailable since the start of the regular season while continuing his recovery process from a lower leg fracture that required a pair of procedures.

items.headline: Fiala (lower leg) was spotted skating in a non-contact jersey at Kings' morning skate Thursday.
items.text: Fiala's presence at Thursday's practice is an encouraging sign for the Kings, as he's been sidelined since the 2026 Olympics after fracturing his lower leg in Switzerland's group-stage game against Canada. The 30-year-old winger compiled 18 goals, 40 points and 146 shots on net across 56 regular-season outings in the 2025-26 campaign. It remains to be seen how close he is to returning to the lineup, but when he does, he'll add major offensive firepower for the Kings, who currently rank 27th in the NHL with just 2.55 goals per game to start the season. He's a great player to stash on an IR spot in fantasy for the time being.

items.text: Mantha picked up one assist over 13:58 of ice time prior to his exit. The winger left the game in the third period, which partially explains the lack of an update. Keefe added that Mantha would be evaluated when the team gets back to New Jersey. The Devils are off until Tuesday's game versus the Oilers, so Mantha will have a little more time than normal to recover before he'd be at risk of missing games.
